name: arpinine-harness
description: Governed product-engineering workflow for Codex using shared Arpinine Harness artifacts

interface.shortDescription: Governed workflow for product and engineering delivery
interface.longDescription: Adds shared specification, planning, review, and governance workflows to Codex using the Arpinine Harness core. Specialist agents cover product intent, architecture, domain language, TDD, security, AI design, DevOps, and data engineering.
defaultPrompt: Use Arpinine Harness to initialize a governed delivery workflow for this repository.
Use Arpinine Harness to decompose a broad product goal into a project brief and feature backlog. Run /arpinine-harness:at-map to start.
Use Arpinine Harness to brainstorm an idea with the product-owner one question at a time before creating a spec. Run /arpinine-harness:at-discover to start.
Use Arpinine Harness to create or refine a spec before implementation starts.
